functions.reason: Reviewed loops against original offsets and scalar multiply ordering. Actual MSVC fragment matches instructions; edge tests compare float bits, MXCSR and untouched translation. Earlier portable GCC NaN differences receive no credit.

Reviewed prefix 0xe1c, six tables of 280 pointers, column-first visits, vtable slot 4, null skips and unchanged entries. Native-fragment callbacks test aliasing and mutation of future entries. Callback semantics beyond the call and unwind behavior remain unknown.

Reviewed null guard, unsigned wrapping decrement at object+4, zero-only virtual slot-0 call with flag 1 and unchanged slot. Native-fragment tests cover zero, one, wraparound, normal counts, callback identity and guards.
Reviewed each constructor store and untouched gap. Fixed 0x9fe7e0 is genuine vtable data, not encoded instructions. Actual native fragment preserves gaps and returns the object in sampled tests.

integrity_review: Readable self-contained source; no directives, instruction arrays, assembly, post-build edits, masked relocations or trimmed padding
Fresh native Windows MSVC and original-free sandbox MSVC builds produce identical complete code sections
Pinned independent checker compares both source-built sections and test-reference sections with the immutable original
Behavior tests execute actual Windows-compiled fragments, not earlier portable substitutes
remaining_limits: Function-span certification only; no full linked game or complete portable renderer
Original x86 ABI and data address retained
Unmasked FP traps, invalid objects, concurrency and callback exceptions remain untested
